data.one_liner: Constructor-based compile-time dependency injection framework for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides compile-time dependency injection using annotations and code generation. It wires services explicitly via constructors and modules without relying on runtime reflection or global state.
use_when: You want compile-time validation for missing dependencies and cycles
You prefer explicit constructor-based dependency injection without runtime lookups
You are building a Flutter application that benefits from typed view model factories and zero reflection overhead
avoid_when: You prefer runtime dependency injection or service-locator patterns like get_it
You do not want to use code generation and build_runner in your workflow
strengths: Compile-time validation catches wiring issues and cycles early
Zero runtime overhead and no reflection
Refactor-safe with strong Flutter and view model integration
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation
data.setup_notes: Add inject_annotation and build_runner with inject_generator as dev dependencies, then run build_runner.

alternatives.name: injectable
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more annotation-friendly abstraction on top of get_it service locator rather than pure compile-time constructor injection.

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a simpler runtime service locator instead of generating compile-time components.
